name: Tentacle Tresses
text:
Instead of hair, prehensile tentacles hang from your head, reaching nearly to your waist. The tentacles might be as fine as hair or as thick as a humanoid thumb.

Activate—Helping Hair r (concentrate)

Trigger You attempt a manipulate action that is disrupted

---
Effect Your tentacle tresses help you complete the action. Attempt a DC 15 Flat check. If you succeed, your action isn't disrupted.
